title: Declared components travel in 'consumer-session/create' as 'config.components', as written.
why: behavioural spec 'janus': when the options declare components, 'consumer-session/create' carries them as 'config.components', each declaration as written except that a 'file' source's relative 'reference' is made absolute against the working directory. No declaration is checked, fetched or opened by the SDK.
note: The reference is absolute, so the case means the same in every language whatever its working directory. Nothing exists at it: a scripted engine loads nothing, and an SDK that opened the file would fail here.
